q1_issues.issue: The `quantity` scale of `Degree` is defined only for the too-much / too-little / enough construction with the three fixed markers excessive / insufficient / sufficient, so the level symbol `massive` is outside the licensed set for that slot.

q2_gaps: unquantified mass-quantity expressions — "a massive amount of <mass noun>", "a great deal of", "a large quantity of": no numeral so Measure does not apply, no members so GroupOf/CardinalityPhrase does not apply, and the Degree `quantity` construction is restricted to too much / too little / enough

entity-attached non-containment spatial prepositions ("all over the floor", "on the table", "under the bench"): the only head defined for where a THING is is LocatedIn (containment/position), while the "wool from Calderwick" precedent instead keeps the surface preposition on the entity — nothing decides which applies here, and "all over" (spread across a surface) is lost either way
notes: Past is wrapped around the Degree and LocatedIn predications but not around (Member sk_blood_1 blood), so the existential's own "there was" claim reads as untensed; this is defensible as referent projection but the instruction set's rule says the surface tense wraps every categorical atom the clause yields.
